responsibility: Implements the stdarg optimization and va_arg lowering pass for GIMPLE. It expands IFN_VA_ARG internal calls using target hooks, analyzes va_list use/escape patterns in variadic functions, determines how much register-save area is actually needed for GPR and FPR arguments on targets with special stdarg handling, and records reduced va_list save requirements while preserving SSA and CFG correctness after lowering.
same_name_distinction: Implements stdarg optimization and va_arg lowering, including va_list escape/use analysis, register-save sizing, IFN_VA_ARG expansion, and the stdarg/lower_vaarg passes. Unlike the header, this file contains the analysis and pass logic rather than just the state structure used by it.
